controls.control: Junior first-team inclusion and safeguarding applicability
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Junior participant sign-in is only activated after verified policy and protected-data authorisation
controls.negativeCase: A junior profile cannot become live through a QA role picker

controls.requiredEvidence: accountable legal entity, regulator applicability and incident delegation record
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Actual controller obligations, operator duties and team/club escalation are separately documented
controls.negativeCase: A platform label does not erase a club's statutory obligations

controls.requiredEvidence: proposed individual identity, email and emergency-contact processing specification
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Registration methods and guardian candidate fields have purpose-specific security boundaries
controls.negativeCase: Signing in with Apple/Google or entering a candidate contact creates no verified guardian grant

controls.requiredEvidence: field-by-field purpose, age, necessity, access and retention assessment
controls.acceptanceCriterion: All five requested mandatory and six optional categories are evaluated individually before collecting any
controls.negativeCase: Requested address/photo and optional school/social fields are not automatically mandatory for every child

controls.requiredEvidence: child account model, guardian proof and consent assessment
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Junior may have own login; guardian contact exists only as unactivated candidate until verified
controls.negativeCase: A recorded candidate cannot read a child's data or receive automatic access

controls.requiredEvidence: independent guardian verification/revocation procedure and audit evidence
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Appointed human team Manager verifies requested activation with safeguards against self-approval
controls.negativeCase: An unverified, expired or disputed guardian request cannot activate access

controls.control: Emergency contacts only in first release
controls.requiredEvidence: purpose-limited emergency contact inventory with medical-field exclusions
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Emergency access is exact-team/purpose-limited and audited; no health data included
controls.negativeCase: Medical history, injury and concussion information are rejected from initial collection

controls.control: Team Manager and Club Admin scoped reads
controls.requiredEvidence: server-enforced role/club/team field projections and access audit tests
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Only independently granted roles read the minimum authorised personal/contact fields
controls.negativeCase: Other team/club, coach or volunteer cannot gain details from dropdown or direct URL

controls.requiredEvidence: versioned notices and default-off consent/withdrawal evidence
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Terms/privacy acknowledgement is required; marketing is separate, optional and reversible
controls.negativeCase: Deny marketing after withdrawal or when unchecked, without denying sporting participation

controls.requiredEvidence: compared provider/plan/cost, identity, child processing, contracts and exit assessment
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Supplier selection is separately approved before any hosted account or record is created
controls.negativeCase: A source PR or a sample Supabase suggestion never provisions a provider

controls.requiredEvidence: actual processing countries and APP/subprocessor transfer review
controls.acceptanceCriterion: International supplier choice is evaluated without an Australian-only presumption
controls.negativeCase: Overseas storage is not deemed exempt from privacy duties merely because data is not financial

controls.requiredEvidence: recipient association verification, purpose-specific field projection and audit
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Only verified registration/eligibility/fixture recipients receive minimum required fields
controls.negativeCase: Bulk export, unrelated club read or third-party marketing are denied

controls.requiredEvidence: dated membership lifecycle, archive permissions, legal holds and field-retention schedule
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Member is inactive at departure and archived after 12 months, without automatic record deletion
controls.negativeCase: Archive does not enable unaudited access or imply indefinite retention of every private field

controls.control: Self-service profile correction and platform rights
controls.requiredEvidence: email verification, personal correction and team/club rights request procedures
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Player may correct own email/phone/address; operator handles team/club records requests
controls.negativeCase: Player cannot edit another person's profile, claim a club grant or bypass email change verification

controls.requiredEvidence: encrypted backup, least-privilege restore, recovery tests and deletion/exit evidence
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Only platform operator can initiate controlled database restore; retention/erasure are documented
controls.negativeCase: Appointed Team Manager and Club Admin cannot restore hosted database

controls.control: Incident process without initial in-app report form
controls.requiredEvidence: external reporting channel, escalation procedure, access audit and breach test
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Operator receives and responds to incidents without requiring an in-app reporting feature
controls.negativeCase: Absence of incident button cannot mean absence of incident escalation or access audit

controls.control: Mandatory account acceptance and volunteer WWCC field
controls.requiredEvidence: terms notice versioning; child-law applicability; private WWCC field, credential verification and role policies
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Acceptance precedes app use, separate optional marketing remains; junior-facing volunteer WWCC requires a private field and verified status
controls.negativeCase: Checkbox alone cannot waive law and an entered WWCC number never equals verified clearance

controls.control: Platform operator final signoff; team/club attestations
controls.requiredEvidence: independent reviews, real release evidence, operational attestations and explicit operator approval
controls.acceptanceCriterion: Only platform operator makes final product go-live decision after L0–L6 and eight journeys are qualified
controls.negativeCase: Completing the questionnaire or merging a PR cannot approve release

designJourneys.title: Junior/player registration with privacy acceptance
stages: Identity is independently verified by future selected provider
Show understandable versioned terms and privacy collection notice
Require affirmative acceptance to proceed, record notice version/time
Offer separate optional marketing consent, default off
Record guardian candidate details without activating a guardian login or grant
Deny live junior account activation until child/guardian and provider reviews are accepted
negativeCases: Declined terms blocks activation; does not opt into marketing
No click, no version or forged acceptance denies activation
Self-reported guardian contact cannot grant guardian access
Unapproved provider or missing child privacy authorisation denies live use

designJourneys.title: Optional guardian activation by appointed human team Manager
designJourneys.user: Appointed team Manager reviewing a guardian access request
stages: Capture request for existing guardian candidate, without sending automatic invitation
Verify identity and relationship using separately approved evidence procedure
Check conflict-of-interest and role/team scope; log reviewed determination
Grant only approved guardian permissions on validated success
Support revocation, disputes and minor age transition
negativeCases: Candidate-only or unverified guardian cannot access junior data
Manager cannot self-verify personal/related request without independent control
Revoked, unrelated-team or expired permission denies access

designJourneys.title: Junior-facing volunteer credentials
designJourneys.user: Volunteer and authorised junior safeguarding verifier
stages: Junior-facing assignment proposes private Working With Children Check field on volunteer profile
Determine state or territory and role applicability or exemptions
Record identifier only in private approved storage, with minimum necessary access
Independently verify current credential and record status, recheck or expiry
Allow relevant duty only after independent safeguarding rule and grant checks
negativeCases: Entered WWCC number does not assert valid credential
Unverified, expired or wrong-jurisdiction status cannot certify duty eligibility
No WWCC number or verification status is exported to player or public club directory

designJourneys.title: Departing member inactive, then archived
designJourneys.user: Appointed team Manager and platform retention reviewer
stages: Membership ends and player/volunteer team participation becomes inactive
Restrict normal roster access and former member operational permissions
After 12 months of inactive status move record to restricted archive
Do not automatically delete record solely because period elapsed
Evaluate per-field retention, legal holds, access requests and backup expiry separately
negativeCases: Inactive member cannot retain active team privilege by stale session
Archive is not unguarded browse or indefinite retention permission
Automated time passage cannot delete the entire historical record

designJourneys.title: First-team launch approval
stages: Verify privacy and legal-controller allocation against all 18 decisions
Collect team Manager and Club Admin operational attestations
Review provider identity, server scope, real security and recovery evidence
Confirm all L0–L6 gates and eight live first-team journeys with exact SHA
Record separate final platform operator approval and independently check installed runtime
negativeCases: Questionnaire 18/18 without independent reviews denies release
Merge, green synthetic CI or static Pages publish cannot qualify personal-data processing
Team/Club attestations cannot substitute for platform operator approval
